description: This file defines a React hook and a utility function for progressively applying work batches in a React application, optimizing rendering and UI responsiveness. It includes creation and management of a controller that handles batching using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback, along with a React hook to integrate this functionality into React components.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages the progressive application of work batches, handling scheduling via requestIdleCallback or setTimeout, progress reporting, and cancellation.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps createProgressiveExpandController, managing UI state for start, progress, and cancel actions, and providing an easy API for progressive work application within React components.

ctags.signature: ({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })

ctags.signature: ({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
